message.content:
In this repository (working directory /bench/home/work), find where "memo" objects have derived/computed metadata that is extracted from their content rather than set by the user — this metadata is used for lists/previews (e.g., things like word count, reading time, title extraction, excerpt/summary, tags extraction, etc. computed from memo content/body).

Please:
1. Find the model/schema definition for "memo" (grep for "memo" across the codebase, look at types/interfaces/database schema).
2. Find the specific function/method that computes derived metadata from a memo's content.
3. Identify what triggers recomputation (e.g., on create, on update/save, before save hook, API endpoint, background job, etc.) — cite exact file/line and the hook mechanism (e.g. Mongoose pre-save hook, Prisma middleware, explicit service call, etc.)
4. Identify exactly what properties/fields are extracted/derived (e.g., title, excerpt, word count, reading time, plain text stripped of markdown, first image, etc.)

Cite exact file paths and line numbers for everything. Report back concisely with citations.

## Summary

This is the **usememos/memos** Go backend (note-taking app). "Memo" objects have derived metadata computed from markdown content, used for previews/lists.

### 2. Function(s) that compute derived metadata

All in `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (goldmark-based `markdown.Service`):
- **`ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error)`** — lines 356-422. Single-pass walk that extracts `Tags`, `Mentions`, and `Property{Title, HasLink, HasCode, HasTaskList, HasIncompleteTasks}` together (this is the one actually used for memo payload rebuilds — "efficient" single parse).
- `ExtractProperties(content []byte)` — lines 193-241 (same property logic, standalone/unused-by-rebuild variant).
- `GenerateSnippet(content []byte, maxLength int) (string, error)` — lines 264-346: strips markdown to plain text, truncates at word boundary (used for preview snippets, **not stored**, computed on every read).
- `ExtractedData` struct — lines 21-25.

### 3. What triggers recomputation

The rebuild wrapper: `func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error` at `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`. It calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(...)` and sets `memo.Payload.Tags` / `memo.Payload.Property`.

It is invoked explicitly (no ORM hook/middleware — this is plain Go/sqlx, not an ORM with lifecycle hooks) at:
- **Create**: `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` inside `CreateMemo`, before `s.Store.CreateMemo(ctx, create)`.
- **Update**: `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` inside `UpdateMemo`, only when the `content` field path is present in the update mask (line 436 `if path == "content"`), before `s.Store.UpdateMemo(ctx, update)`.
- **Batch/maintenance job**: `Runner.RunOnce(ctx)` at `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` rebuilds payloads for all memos in batches of 100 and persists via `Store.UpdateMemo`. **Notably, this runner is not registered anywhere** — `/bench/home/work/server/server.go:153-175` (`startBackgroundRunners`) only wires up `s3presign.NewRunner`; `memopayload.NewRunner`/`RunOnce` has no caller in the codebase (grep confirms zero references outside its own file), so it's effectively dead/manual-only code, not an active cron job.

Separately, **`Snippet` is not stored at all** — it's computed on every read/conversion via `getMemoContentSnippet` (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-89`, calling `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`), invoked from `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` at `/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80` and similarly for related-memo snippets (lines 221-273) and notification snippets (`/bench/home/work/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318-391`).

### 4. Exact fields extracted/derived

From `internal/markdown/markdown.go` `ExtractAll` (persisted into `MemoPayload`):
- `Title` — extracted from the first H1 heading if it's the first block-level element (lines 384-388, helper `extractHeadingText`).
- `HasLink` — true if any markdown link node present (line 393-394).
- `HasCode` — true if any code block/fenced code block/code span present (lines 396-397).
- `HasTaskList` — true if any task checkbox present (lines 399-400).
- `HasIncompleteTasks` — true if any unchecked task checkbox present (lines 401-404).
- `Tags` — `#tag` nodes collected and deduplicated case-preserving (line 377, 418, helper `uniquePreserveCase`).
- `Mentions` — `@username` mention nodes, lowercased and deduplicated (line 379-380, 419) — used for notification dispatch (`memo_mention_helpers.go`), not stored in `MemoPayload`.

Computed at read-time (not stored):
- `Snippet` — plain-text summary, markdown stripped, code blocks skipped, truncated to `maxLength` (default 64 chars) at a word boundary (`GenerateSnippet`, lines 264-346).

Not derived from content (user/request-set, for completeness): `Location` (lat/long/placeholder) is set from the request, not extracted from text (`memo_service.go:112`, `:483`).
